doc: One wind bone: a stretch of stem or branch that bends as one, about its pivot.

fields.name: parent
fields.doc: Parent bone, or -1 for the root.

fields.name: pivot
fields.doc: Where it bends, in the rest pose (metres, shrub space).

fields.name: axis
fields.doc: Unit direction along the wood, from the pivot.

fields.name: drag
fields.doc: Bend in radians at a steady 10 m/s wind.
